name: kepler-gl
description: kepler.gl skills for AI assistants: create standalone HTML maps from Python data with keplergl, and drive a live kepler.gl map with map.* commands (layers, time animation, basemaps).

interface.shortDescription: Create maps with keplergl or a live kepler.gl app
interface.longDescription: Two skills in one plugin: build standalone HTML maps from DataFrames, GeoDataFrames, GeoJSON or CSV with the keplergl Python package, and create or restyle layers, animate time, compare split views and change the basemap on a running kepler.gl app through its map.* commands.
defaultPrompt: Create an interactive map visualization from this data
Show these points on the open kepler.gl map, colored by visits
